           <h1>Meshery v0.7.110</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.110">Released</a> on October 02, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Docs] MAINTAINERS: Update maintainer list  @Vaibhav701161 (#12167)</li>
  <li>[chore] Fix failing <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">go static check</code>. @MUzairS15 (#12126)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Add Field Descriptions Meshery CRDs @TomiwaAribisala-git (#11674)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix loading of user session ( organization ,keys, roles ) @aabidsofi19 (#12216)</li>
  <li>remove handleLogout from signin button @aabidsofi19 (#12212)</li>
  <li>feat(loading-screen-for-root-app): loading screen for the root app @jerensl (#12209)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix redirect from modal @MUzairS15 (#12200)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>ci(build-ui-and-server-reusable-workflow): refactor the cache @jerensl (#12189)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix redirect from modal @MUzairS15 (#12200)</li>
  <li>disable dispatching of meshery extensions rollout on release @MUzairS15 (#12147)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Add extension version in extensions bug issue template @hamza-mohd (#12158)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Remove mesheryctl version from UI bug issue template @pontusringblom (#12159)</li>
  <li>[CI] build-ui-and-server: install playwright manually @jerensl (#12175)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>week-of-09-30-2024 @Deathnote45 (#12179)</li>
  <li>chore: rm unused files @vishalvivekm (#12182)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Deathnote45, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @TomiwaAribisala-git, @Vaibhav701161, @aabidsofi19, @hamza-mohd, @jerensl, @leecalcote, @pontusringblom, @sudhanshutech and @vishalvivekm</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.111</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.111">Released</a> on October 04, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>remove redudant models and components w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#12225)</li>
  <li>[chore] Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshkit</code> to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v0.7.79</code> @MUzairS15 (#12257)</li>

        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  var url = "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=meshery/meshery";
  fetch(url, { 
      headers: {"Accept":"application/vnd.github.preview"}
  }).then(function(e) {
    return e.json()
  }).then(function(r) {
     console.log(r.items[0])
     stars = r.items[0]['stargazers_count']
     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.114</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.114">Released</a> on October 05, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>

</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix Relation evaluation  crash @aabidsofi19 (#12286)</li>
  <li>fix notification center bugs @aabidsofi19 (#12285)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>

</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@MUzairS15, @aabidsofi19 and @alphaX86</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })

      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.118</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.118">Released</a> on October 07, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump rollup from 2.70.2 to 2.79.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#12143)</li>
  <li>chore(docker-build): improve docker build for ui and provider @jerensl (#12295)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>update rels w/singoff @Jougan-0 (#12302)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 14.2.7 to 14.2.14 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12202)</li>
  <li>Randomize loading messages @aabidsofi19 (#12300)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.11.5 to 11.13.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12203)</li>
  <li>Add Hamburger menu @aabidsofi19 (#12296)</li>
  <li>Feat: Enhance Design Export Modal @aabidsofi19 (#12297)</li>
  <li>[Chore] E2E Tests: fix typo on test tag @jerensl (#12303)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 14.2.7 to 14.2.14 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12202)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.11.5 to 11.13.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12203)</li>
  <li>[Chore] E2E Tests: fix typo on test tag @jerensl (#12303)</li>
  <li>upgrade  snapshot action version @Aijeyomah (#12298)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.12</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.12">Released</a> on January 23, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>added capabilities for edges @captain-Akshay (#10048)</li>
  <li>update meshsync crd @MUzairS15 (#10057)</li>
  <li>[Relationships] Add selectors sets in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">relationships</code>. @MUzairS15 (#9987)</li>
  <li>Update grafana_helper.go @eltociear (#9981)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix remote pattern upload @MUzairS15 (#10014)</li>
  <li>[Server] Validate <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">userid</code> and handle remote provider responses on failure correctly. @MUzairS15 (#10015)</li>
  <li>[bug] Fix Remote Design file upload @theBeginner86 (#10013)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix developer warnings @JyothiSwaroopReddy07 (#10029)</li>
  <li>Added new icons for Kubernetes components @nwanduka (#9866)</li>
  <li>[WIP] Migrate registry page to use RTK @Yashsharma1911 (#10007)</li>
  <li>[NOTIFICATION] Added visual indication for notification center @captain-Akshay (#10030)</li>
  <li>fix grammer issue in popup ui comopnents @amitamrutiya2210 (#10028)</li>
  <li>[UI] Refactor tooltip and its behaviour in dashboard cards @sudhanshutech (#10042)</li>
  <li>[RTK] Connections api migrate to rtk @senali-d (#9992)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix publishing design @Yashsharma1911 (#9990)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel Category] Database category icon added  @ritiksaxena124 (#10006)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Update meshmap.yml @theBeginner86 (#10055)</li>
  <li>[chore] Update meshmap.yml @MUzairS15 (#10054)</li>
  <li>[Bug] Reinitialise <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models</code> and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">keys</code> registration on Database reset. @MUzairS15 (#10024)</li>
  <li>[models] Consolidate Meshery Docs Generator @theBeginner86 (#9941)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>broken link fixed w/signoff @prathyushmadhu (#9960)</li>
  <li>#9935 changed the link from /guides/configuration-management/creating-a-meshrey-design to /guides/creating-a-meshrey-design @muthu9594 (#9982)</li>
  <li>[Fixed Docs Cloud Native app Configuration] - Grammar adjustment @shourya2002-geek (#10012)</li>
  <li>v0.4, v0.5, v0.6 added to excludes @iArchitSharma (#10051)</li>
  <li>Fix developer warnings @JyothiSwaroopReddy07 (#10029)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Suggested Reading bug fix @iArchitSharma (#10020)</li>
  <li>modified provider urls @JyothiSwaroopReddy07 (#10027)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] MeshModel to Model fix @iArchitSharma (#10031)</li>
  <li>[docs] fix “Managing Events with Notification Center” link not working properly @dottharun (#10044)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Relationships: Grammar fix in the “Design Relationships and Restrictions” section @neerajmanivarnan (#10003)</li>
  <li>[Docs Designs] Removed Repeated Phrase #9995 Fixed @ASK-03 (#10001)</li>
  <li>Added mesherycli cheatsheet @Dhanush0369 (#10022)</li>
  <li>[docs] Fix YAML issue in Meshery Docs @theBeginner86 (#10021)</li>
  <li>[models] Consolidate Meshery Docs Generator @theBeginner86 (#9941)</li>
  <li>Made grammatical changes for the paragraph under ‘Importing Applications’. @ayushgml (#10018)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@ASK-03, @Dhanush0369, @JyothiSwaroopReddy07, @MUzairS15, @Yashsharma1911, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya2210, @ayushgml, @captain-Akshay, @dottharun, @eltociear, @iArchitSharma, @leecalcote, @muthu9594, @neerajmanivarnan, @nwanduka, @prathyushmadhu, @ritiksaxena124, @senali-d, @shourya2002-geek, @sudhanshutech, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        allLogos.forEach((e) => (e.src = e.dataset.logoForLight));
      }
    </script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.120</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.120">Released</a> on October 08, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>bump meshkit w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#12323)</li>
  <li>update comps and remove hardcoding w/singoff @Jougan-0 (#12322)</li>
  <li>[Server] Enhance redirection based on release channels. @MUzairS15 (#12315)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Goreleaser upgrade to v2 and cleanup of repo root @leecalcote (#12321)</li>
  <li>fix: Update golden file causing panic @lekaf974 (#12314)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix build failed issue and add react-json-view for registry  @amitamrutiya (#12320)</li>
  <li>Revert \Fix: add json data into registry page\ @aabidsofi19 (#12319)</li>
  <li>dont show signup button inplace of menu for anonymous users @aabidsofi19 (#12316)</li>
  <li>Fix: add json data into registry page @amitamrutiya (#12221)</li>
  <li>Revert \Revert [Chore] E2E Tests: fix typo on test tag\ @aabidsofi19 (#12312)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Goreleaser upgrade to v2 and cleanup of repo root @leecalcote (#12321)</li>
  <li>Revert \Revert [Chore] E2E Tests: fix typo on test tag\ @aabidsofi19 (#12312)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @jerensl, @leecalcote and @lekaf974</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.122</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.122">Released</a> on October 17, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Add trim param in meshmodels API @Yashsharma1911 (#12367)</li>
  <li>rego policies for relationships w/singoff @Jougan-0 (#12351)</li>
  <li>Allow getting entities by ids @Yashsharma1911 (#12361)</li>
  <li>Fix environment connections not getting fetched in local provider @Yashsharma1911 (#12349)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: unit test / integration test issue due to console special characters @lekaf974 (#12327)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Chore] UI: Update @sistent/sistent version to 0.14.97 in package.json and package-lock.json @leecalcote (#12348)</li>
  <li>fix: typo in loading screen @ianrwhitney (#12353)</li>
  <li>test(annotation): add annotation for failing feature @jerensl (#12331)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>moved /regal to /policies/wasm.policies @moiz2405 (#12226)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Revert \Update designs.md\ @leecalcote (#12360)</li>
  <li>Migrated all screenshots to separate folders in tutorials @Pratik-050 (#12053)</li>
  <li>Update designs.md @Jougan-0 (#12356)</li>
  <li>add designs containing related models on integration pages @CalebZoe (#12352)</li>
  <li>Create vivek-vishal.md @vishalvivekm (#12338)</li>
  <li>Create Kean-Serna.md @imkurosaki (#12347)</li>
  <li>Create Ayush-Sharma.md @meAyushSharma (#12340)</li>
  <li>Create gaurav-shandilya.md @void-hr (#12341)</li>
  <li>Create Aryan_Nargotra.md @aryannargotra (#12339)</li>
  <li>Create aryannargotra @aryannargotra (#12342)</li>
  <li>Create ashparsh-pandey.md @Ashparshp (#12343)</li>
  <li>Create Ziad-Hany.md @ziadhany (#12345)</li>
  <li>Create Hargun-Kaur.md @hargunkaur286 (#12337)</li>
  <li>Create david.md @davidudale (#12344)</li>
  <li>Marking attendance for newcomer’s meeting for the week of 7th October 2024 @Denish3436 (#12346)</li>
  <li>Create Aryan-Raj.md @Aryan4884 (#12336)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aryan4884, @Ashparshp, @CalebZoe, @Denish3436, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @Pratik-050, @Yashsharma1911, @aabidsofi19, @aryannargotra, @davidudale, @hargunkaur286, @ianrwhitney, @imkurosaki, @jerensl, @l5io, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @meAyushSharma, @moiz2405, @pontusringblom, @sudhanshutech, @vishalvivekm, @void-hr, @ziadhany and ian  whitney</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.123</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.123">Released</a> on October 17, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>bump meshkit w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#12422)</li>
  <li>update relationship def w/singoff @Jougan-0 (#12417)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Figure environment create command panic error#11314 @JianMinTang (#12384)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix support for markdown in notifications @sudhanshutech (#12408)</li>
  <li>[Ci]: save test trace and fix fail actions @jerensl (#12397)</li>
  <li>chore: remove storybook packages from dev-deps @nebula-aac (#12391)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.129</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.129">Released</a> on October 30, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>remove generic node from the shapes @amitamrutiya (#12517)</li>
  <li>add missing components w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#12505)</li>
  <li>Bump http-proxy-middleware from 2.0.4 to 2.0.7 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#12479)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: update parsinggithub test to prevent failing issue @lekaf974 (#12371)</li>
  <li>Minify and flatten Kubeconfig on Meshery UI @Alero-Awani (#11987)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>bump: sistent version @amitamrutiya (#12518)</li>
  <li>feat:added delete playwright test @ianrwhitney (#12326)</li>
  <li>[UI] Formatted json data into design card @kingdarabahmad (#12387)</li>
  <li>fix bug onclick avatar @sudhanshutech (#12512)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix bug onclick avatar @sudhanshutech (#12512)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Rename meshmap.yml to .yml @vishalvivekm (#12496)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>feat:added delete playwright test @ianrwhitney (#12326)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Alero-Awani, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @dependabot, @ianrwhitney, @jerensl, @kingdarabahmad, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @sudhanshutech and @vishalvivekm</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.13</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.13">Released</a> on January 25, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Add new entry for AYA Innovation Labs as adopter @Yashsharma1911 (#10092)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] run <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">gofmt</code> on server. @MUzairS15 (#10084)</li>
  <li>feat: responsive pagination for mesheryctl exp list cmd @RipulHandoo (#10069)</li>
  <li>[bug/mesheryctl] Fix Import/Onboard @theBeginner86 (#10065)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Update publish catalog request payload @Yashsharma1911 (#10091)</li>
  <li>[General] - Dark mode issue in transfer modal @senali-d (#10088)</li>
  <li>add missing tooltip and refactor its styling @sudhanshutech (#10086)</li>
  <li>Fix CASL typo from actions to action in performance page @Yashsharma1911 (#10087)</li>
  <li>[Components] Improve default field descriptions @leecalcote (#10067)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug/mesheryctl] Fix Import/Onboard @theBeginner86 (#10065)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Revert “Update error-codes-updater.yaml” @MUzairS15 (#10090)</li>
  <li>Update error-codes-updater.yaml @MUzairS15 (#10089)</li>
  <li>add conditional to use token only on master branch for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">error-code-util</code> @MUzairS15 (#10085)</li>
  <li>use GitHub PAT for checkoing out repo @MUzairS15 (#10083)</li>
  <li>Bump Screenshot Service version @theBeginner86 (#10081)</li>
  <li>Update generate_keys.yml @MUzairS15 (#10064)</li>
  <li>Update generate_keys.yml @MUzairS15 (#10063)</li>
  <li>[CI] Enhance Keys workflow with published CSV @leecalcote (#10062)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Error Code Reference Layout @leecalcote (#10075)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-security">🔒 Security</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Enhance Keys workflow with published CSV @leecalcote (#10062)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@MUzairS15, @RipulHandoo, @Yashsharma1911, @l5io, @leecalcote, @senali-d, @sudhanshutech and @theBeginner86</p>
